system.description:
Meeting a beast's eyes and answering it in kind — a growl, a hiss, a chirp — you speak to it in the wordless tongue of predators, and your own predatory nature bends it toward you.

You may converse with an animal freely and without any test, so long as you hold its gaze; break eye contact and you must re-establish it to keep speaking. The power reaches only creatures that have eyes and enough of a mind or Beast to grasp — it works best on predators and larger birds, reptiles and mammals, not on eyeless or very simple beasts. To make an animal obey rather than merely parley, you must defeat it in a Social Challenge (a Narrator generally rates the creature at roughly six to eight Traits). Success secures its obedience for the rest of the evening, though it can carry out only simple tasks such as fetching, following or guarding, not complex or conditional orders. Retest with Animal Ken.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
